entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Eyeless, single-clawed, snaking hive-species creatures spread across all five colors, held up as the model Magic exclusive.

entities.name: Baloths
entities.description: Large quadrupedal, horned and clawed Beasts first met in Otaria, lacking a consistent visual identity.

entities.name: Hellions
entities.description: Wormlike, destructive monsters that burst from stony ground, with scaly serpentine bodies and tentacle-ringed mouths.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Distinctive broods that emerged on and annihilated Zendikar, not yet seen in another block.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Disposable servant-creatures manufactured from cast-off tissue to serve the Order of the Ebon Hand, later seen in the Orzhov guild.

entities.name: Masticores
entities.description: Artificial, flightless manticore-like creatures seen mainly on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Kavu
entities.description: A creature type seen in Invasion and Time Spiral blocks, both on Dominaria.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Creatures whose origins are tied to Memnarch, seen only on Mirrodin so far.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Onetime guardian of the metal plane Mirrodin, to whom the Myr's origins are tied.

entities.name: Phelddagrifs
entities.description: Distinctive creatures seen in Alliances and Planeshift, welcomed as Magic exclusives.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: A lizardlike and belligerent race seen on Ravnica, Alara and Dominaria.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: An albino-looking, nomadic race seen on Rath and Zendikar.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: A squat, tightly-knit race that had its heyday in the Lorwyn and Shadowmoor year.

entities.name: Wurms
entities.description: Big omnivorous worm-monsters, a mainstay of green creature lineups seen on many planes.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: A group served by thrulls manufactured from cast-off tissue.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that employs thrulls.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane emerged upon and annihilated by the Eldrazi; baloths and kor appear here.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane where Masticores and Myr have been seen, once guarded by Memnarch.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane home to slivers, kavu and Otaria.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where viashino, thrulls and others have been seen.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin Planeswalker, jokingly said to be ready to claw the columnist's face.

events.summary: The columnist inducts Phelddagrifs as Magic exclusives.
The columnist inducts viashino, kor and kithkin as Magic exclusives.
The columnist declares wurms all Magic.

relations.note: Thrulls are manufactured to serve the Order.
relations.quote: Anything manufactured from cast-off tissue to serve the Order of the Ebon Hand deserves our underdog-loving sympathy.

relations.note: Thrulls appear as part of the Orzhov guild.
relations.quote: We've seen them not only back in Tempest block and the Fallen Empires storyline, but also on the plane of Ravnica as part of the Orzhov guild.

relations.note: The Myr's origins are tied to Memnarch.
relations.quote: They even have their origins explicitly tied to Memnarch, onetime guardian of the metal plane, and yet I wouldn't be shocked at all to see them brought back on some other world.
